title: Gamified Virtual Reality Exposure Therapy for Mysophobia: Evaluating the Efficacy of a Simulated Sneeze Intervention
reasoning: The paper is a clinical study evaluating the efficacy of a virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET) intervention for mysophobia. It focuses on psychological affect and anxiety measurements (PANAS and STAI-S) and does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
